itinerary.title: Arrival – Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Pickup at Bagdogra airport or NJP station and drive (about 3 hrs) up through tea gardens to Darjeeling. Evening on the Mall Road (Chowrasta). Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Very early drive to Tiger Hill to watch sunrise over Kanchenjunga (weather permitting), then Ghoom Monastery and the Batasia Loop war memorial. After breakfast visit the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute and zoo (closed Thursdays), a tea garden and the Japanese Peace Pagoda. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling at Leisure – Toy Train & Ropeway
itinerary.description: Breakfast and an easy day – optional joy ride on the UNESCO-listed toy train (own cost), the ropeway over the tea valleys and the Tibetan Refugee Self Help Centre. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling – Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive from Darjeeling to Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) station (about 3.5–4.5 hrs) for your onward journey. Tour ends.

packages.title: North Sikkim Honeymoon – Lachen, Gurudongmar & Lachung 4N/5D
packages.summary: Gurudongmar Lake, Yumthang Valley, remote Himalayan villages.

itinerary.title: Arrival – Gangtok
itinerary.description: Pickup at Bagdogra or NJP and drive to Gangtok (about 4.5 hrs). The team completes the North Sikkim permit. Evening on MG Marg. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Lachen
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive north (about 6–7 hrs) past the Seven Sisters waterfall and Chungthang to Lachen (about 8,800 ft). Early dinner and rest. Overnight stay in Lachen.

itinerary.title: Gurudongmar Lake – Lachung
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn start to Gurudongmar Lake, one of the highest lakes in the world (subject to road and weather). Return to Lachen for lunch and drive to Lachung. Overnight stay in Lachung.

itinerary.title: Yumthang Valley – Gangtok
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit Yumthang Valley – rhododendrons in spring, snow in winter – and the hot spring; optional Zero Point (extra). Return to Gangtok (about 5–6 hrs). Candle-light dinner. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive from Gangtok to Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) station (about 3.5–4.5 hrs) for your onward journey. Tour ends.

packages.title: North East Explorer – Assam, Meghalaya & Arunachal 5N/6D
packages.summary: Three North East states in six days – Meghalaya's waterfalls, Kaziranga's rhinos and the Arunachal foothills.
highlights: Three North East states in six days – Meghalaya's waterfalls, Kaziranga's rhinos and the Arunachal foothills.

itinerary.title: Guwahati – Kamakhya – Shillong
itinerary.description: Pickup at Guwahati and visit Kamakhya Temple. Drive to Shillong (about 3 hrs) with a stop at Umiam Lake. Evening at Police Bazaar. Overnight stay in Shillong.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji (Sohra) Day Trip
itinerary.description: Breakfast and day trip to Cherrapunji – Nohkalikai Falls, the Mawsmai limestone cave, the Seven Sisters Falls and the Eco Park viewpoint over the Bangladesh plains. Return to Shillong. Overnight stay in Shillong.

itinerary.title: Shillong – Kaziranga
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Kaziranga National Park (about 6 hrs). Evening at the resort; optional Orchid park visit. Overnight at Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga Safaris
itinerary.description: Morning jeep safari to see the one-horned rhinoceros, wild buffalo, elephants and birds (safari at own cost); optional early elephant safari. Afternoon tea-garden walk. Overnight at Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga – Bhalukpong (Arunachal)
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive via Tezpur to Bhalukpong on the Assam–Arunachal border (about 4 hrs), with the Inner Line Permit arranged by the team. Visit the Tipi Orchid Centre and relax by the Kameng river. Overnight stay in Bhalukpong.

itinerary.title: Bhalukpong – Guwahati Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Guwahati (about 5 hrs) for your evening flight or train. Tour ends.

packages.title: Mirik, Darjeeling & Gangtok Grand Tour 6N/7D
packages.summary: Mirik, Darjeeling and Gangtok in one relaxed week.
highlights: Mirik, Darjeeling and Gangtok in one relaxed week.

itinerary.title: Arrival – Mirik
itinerary.description: Pickup at Bagdogra or NJP and drive to Mirik (about 2 hrs). Evening around Sumendu Lake. Overnight stay in Mirik.

itinerary.title: Mirik – Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Darjeeling via the Pashupati border market and tea estates. Evening on the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Very early drive to Tiger Hill to watch sunrise over Kanchenjunga (weather permitting), then Ghoom Monastery and the Batasia Loop war memorial. After breakfast visit the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute and zoo (closed Thursdays), a tea garden and the Japanese Peace Pagoda. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling – Gangtok
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive (about 4 hrs) down to the Teesta river and up to Gangtok. Evening stroll on the car-free MG Marg. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.description: Breakfast and excursion to Tsomgo Lake (about 12,300 ft) and Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir (permits arranged by the team); optional Nathu La for Indian citizens at extra cost. Return to Gangtok. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a half/full-day tour of Gangtok – Tashi viewpoint, Rumtek Monastery, Do Drul Chorten, the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, Banjhakri Falls and the ropeway (own cost). Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive from Gangtok to Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri (NJP) station (about 3.5–4.5 hrs) for your onward journey. Tour ends.
